Name: Hidden Power Of The Swarm
Effect: Successive Actions. Choose a Damage-Type for each attack you are making and apply the correlating effect. Bug, Dragon, Fairy, Fighting, Flying, Ground, Normal, Rock, Steel, Water: Add +1 Damage Dice. Dark: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Ghost: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Electric: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Grass: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Leech the Target. Poison: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Poison the Target. Psychic: Roll 2 Chance Dice to put the Target to Sleep. Fire: Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict Burn (1) on the Target. Ice: Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict Frostbite (1) on the Target.
Description: The swarm launches many strange powers at the Foe.
